result.fundName: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth

insights: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 1.81% (15.85% vs 14.04%).
Beat the benchmark in 87.7% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Thematic-International.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.98 vs 0.85) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.23, volatility within 5% of the index.
Positive alpha of 17.82% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.14).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -23.04% vs benchmark -34.16%.
Rolling return range spans 12.50% to 19.21% (6.71 pp spread) — consistency score 93.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
